text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Solaris preview cohort launch moved to Wed 11am PT. Need final checks on enrollment flow, feedback hooks, and renewal-risk signals.
Jonah: Acknowledged. I'll re-run the seat sync and make sure invites have correct role.
Priya: I'll update the enablement checklist. Can we keep the kickoff to 20m + a 10m Q&A? Short is better. :clock1:
Anna: Thanks, Maya. One ask from our side: can we get a short onboarding checklist in the invite (not just a link)? Helps product managers.
Maya: Yes — add a 1-page bullet checklist and Loom. Priya, can you do the 1-pager?
Priya: On it. Drafting with steps: SSO, sample query, API key rotation note. ETA 3pm.
Sam: Technical note: for customers on dedicated infra, the token TTL default differs. Add a note: `token_ttl_hours=24` in the invite.
Maya: Good catch Sam. Also we need to wire survey webhooks so responses land in Gainsight and we can tag renewal risk. DevBot: [deploy] survey-hook created at https://hooks.redwood.internal/survey/solarux
Jonah: For automation: if survey not submitted in 10 days -> add `renewal:at_risk` flag; if usage < 5k tokens in first 2 weeks -> set `renewal:low_engagement`.
Maya: Agree. Include a manual check step for accounts with high billing but low feature usage.
Anna: We'll encourage team to do the sample query and leave one piece of feedback. If we get low NPS, can we auto-request an SE touch?
Sam: Yes, add Gainsight playbook: NPS <= 6 -> assign SE & schedule 30m.
Priya: Survey content draft (4 Qs): 1) How easy was onboarding? 2) Any blockers? 3) Likelihood to recommend (0-10) 4) What feature would help you most?
Maya: Perfect. Also ask legal to pre-check the invite language for dedicated infra customers. Jonah, please add IP whitelist note when applicable.
Jonah: Added in invite template: "If you're on dedicated infra, please whitelist 34.85.77.12/32 and 34.85.77.13/32".
DevBot: [auto] Enrollment form received: 5 responses.
Maya: Final launch checklist for tomorrow: 
- Invite copy (Priya)
- Loom + 1-pager (Priya)
- Seat invites and roles (Jonah)
- Survey + webhook (Maya/Jonah)
- Gainsight playbook & tags (Maya/Sam)
- Dedicated infra notes (Sam/Jonah)
Maya: I'll run a 10:30 smoke test tomorrow. Ping here if you want to join.
Priya: I'll be there and will paste the final invite into #docs when ready.
Sam: Will prepare a tiny baseline dashboard (p95 latency, first-token latency) and attach to invites for customers who asked.
Anna: Thanks everyone — excited to try this out. :pray:
Maya: Great. If any blockers surface, tag me. Otherwise I'll post launch report after day 1.
